      "title": "🔍 Core Concept",
      "properties": {},
      "widgets_values": [
        "This workflow runs **image inpainting** on **Z-Image-Turbo**. The generation stack lives in the **Image Inpainting (Z-Image-Turbo & Fun Union Control)** **subgraph** (Step 2).\n\n## What is local inpainting?\n\n**Local inpainting** means changing **only part of a image** while keeping the rest unchanged.\n\n1. **Load a image** as the starting image.\n2. **Draw a mask** on the region to edit (painted area = regenerate, untouched area = keep).\n3. **Write a prompt** for what should appear inside the mask.\n4. The pipeline builds **inpainting conditioning** from image + mask + prompt — which pixels stay fixed vs. get redrawn.\n5. **Sampling** redraws mainly inside the mask; the rest stays aligned with the original and blends at the edges.\n\nInpainting is **conditional redraw on a masked region**, not full image generation from scratch.\n\n## Why a model patch?\n\n**Z-Image-Turbo** does not support mask-based inpainting on its own. This template uses the **[Fun ControlNet Union](https://huggingface.co/alibaba-pai/Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union)** model patch (selected on the subgraph) to enable local edits.\n\n## On this canvas (what you see)\n\n| Step | Group | What to do |\n|------|-------|------------|\n| 1 | Step 1 — Load Images & Create Mask | Load image, draw and save mask |\n| 2 | Step 2 — Update Prompt Here | Set **prompt**, **denoise**, **shift**, and **patch_model** on the subgraph |\n| 3 | Result | Save or compare output |\n\n## Where are the other nodes?\n\n**Double-click** the subgraph in Step 2 to open **Image Inpainting (Z-Image-Turbo & Fun Union Control)**.\n\nNodes such as `InpaintModelConditioning` and `KSampler` are **inside the subgraph only** — they are **Z-Image-Turbo–specific wiring**, not generic inpainting steps. Read the **Inside the subgraph** note there for details."
      ],
      "color": "#222",
      "bgcolor": "#000"
    },

      "widgets_values": [
        "## Controls on the main canvas\n\nYou only see the **subgraph** node here — not the internal sampler or conditioning nodes.\n\nAdjust these **exposed widgets** on the subgraph (Step 2):\n\n- **denoise** (0.5 – 1.0): inpainting strength — lower = subtler edits, higher = stronger redraw inside the mask\n- **shift**: ModelSampling shift (see Workflow Settings)\n- **patch_model**: Fun ControlNet Union weights\n\n## More detail\n\n**Double-click** the subgraph in Step 2 to open it. See **Inside the subgraph** for how this model wires inpainting (not a generic recipe)."

      "widgets_values": [
        "Guide: [subgraph](https://docs.comfy.org/interface/features/subgraph)\n\n[Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union](https://huggingface.co/alibaba-pai/Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union) is used as a **model patch** inside the subgraph. The base model does not support inpainting by itself; this patch enables **local inpainting** (mask + prompt). The same Union family also supports other control types (Canny, HED, Depth, Pose, MLSD) in other workflows.\n\n## Open the subgraph\n\nOn the canvas, **double-click** **Image Inpainting (Z-Image-Turbo & Fun Union Control)** in **Step 2 — Update Prompt Here**. Internal loaders, inpaint nodes, and sampling live there. See the **Inside the subgraph** note for Z-Image-Turbo–specific node roles.\nGuide: [Subgraph](https://docs.comfy.org/interface/features/subgraph)\n\n## Model Links\n\n**text_encoders**\n\n- [qwen_3_4b.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_3_4b.safetensors)\n\n**diffusion_models**\n\n- [z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors)\n\n**vae**\n\n- [ae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/resolve/main/split_files/vae/ae.safetensors)\n\n**model_patches**\n\n- [Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union-2.1.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/alibaba-pai/Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union-2.1/resolve/main/Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union-2.1.safetensors)\n\n\n## Model Storage Location\n\n```\n📂 ComfyUI/\n├── 📂 models/\n│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/\n│   │   └── qwen_3_4b.safetensors\n│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/\n│   │   └── z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors\n│   ├── 📂 vae/\n│   │   └── ae.safetensors\n│   └── 📂 model_patches/\n│       └── Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union-2.1.safetensors\n```\n\n## Report Issue\n\nNote: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.\n\n- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)\n- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)\n- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)\n"

            "widgets_values": [
              "You are inside **Image Inpainting (Z-Image-Turbo & Fun Union Control)**.\n\nThis wiring is **specific to Z-Image-Turbo + Fun ControlNet Union** — not a universal inpainting template.
